svg.title: UltraClipboard - main window (proposal)
svg.desc: The clipboard history as a list: a search field, a filter by kind, the recording switch, pinned entries first, then entries by day. Every row has a thumbnail, a title, a line naming the kind, size, source application and age, and three actions: copy, edit and delete.
